subject: Early-bird on-prem pricing: conditional discount and SLA packaging
messages:
From: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@medstream.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medstream.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing question (pilot -> prod)

Diego — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Two quick questions from our procurement side as we review: 

1) You mentioned an "early-bird" discount for customers who sign a 24-month commitment after the pilot. Is that a flat percentage or tiered by consumption/seat?
2) We need clarity on how the platform fee is handled for on-prem installs: is it invoiced up-front, amortized monthly, or shown as an annual line item?

We’re trying to map this into our TCO for the coming board meeting. Can you share a short note on conditions for the early-bird discount and any supporting SOW language?

Thanks,
Ellie
Head of Partnerships, MedStream Health

---
Attachment: requirements_inventory.xlsx (referenced)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@medstream.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing question (pilot -> prod)

Ellie — great to hear from you. Short answers up front then a proposed conditional offer below.

1) Early-bird: tiered. For 24-month commits we typically offer 15% off platform fee + a one-time engineering onboarding credit (capped) for pilots that convert within 90 days. If the customer also commits to a minimum node/throughput band we can increase to 20%.
2) Platform fee options: upfront annual invoice, or amortized monthly on the same invoice cadence as support. We can also present it as a capitalized license in SOWs if your finance prefers.

Proposed conditional offer (subject to legal/finance sign-off):
- Pilot success definition: passing the two production readiness gates in SOW (latency SLA and audit log retention).
- If pilot converts to a 24-month Private deployment within 90 days of pilot completion: 18% platform fee discount + one quarter of SRE retainer waived (max $40k).
- If conversion happens after 90 days but within 6 months: 12% discount, no retainer waiver.
- Discount applies only to platform fee, not to per-GPU consumption or third-party infra.

I’m attaching a slimmed SOW and our SLA matrix for reference. Marissa — can you confirm whether we have margin flexibility to take 18% tied to the 90-day clause and the $40k retainer carve-out? Irene — please flag anything in the SOW that must change for the clause to be enforceable.

Best,
Diego
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: MedStream_SOW_draft_v2.pdf, Tiers_and_SLA_matrix.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Jul 2025 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing question (pilot -> prod)

Diego — quick internal note: finance looked at the numbers. We can approve up to 16% platform-fee discount without EPD review if the ARR uplift meets our node band forecast; 18% requires approval from Eugene (rev ops) because it touches our amortized platform revenue assumptions. The $40k retainer waiver is doable but should be timeboxed in the contract (ex: apply to first invoice only). 

If MedStream is willing to sign a 36-month payment schedule (even if the contractual term is 24 months, with prepay), that buys us another 2 pts. But we should keep the higher discount conditional on upfront payment or a 12-month prepay.

Irene — we need a legal-safe phrasing for the pilot-success and onboarding-credit mechanics. Also confirm how to limit the discount so it doesn’t auto-apply to future renewals.

Marissa
Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 04 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing question (pilot -> prod)

Folks — draft legal language below for inclusion in SOW/Order Form. I’m keeping it short and objective to avoid ambiguity.

"Early Conversion Credit": If Customer signs a Private Deployment Order Form for a 24-month term within 90 days of completion of the Pilot (as defined in Section 3.2), Redwood will apply an 18% discount to the Platform Fee for the initial contract term and issue a one-time onboarding credit of up to USD 40,000 to be applied against the first invoice. Discount applies solely to the Platform Fee and not to infrastructure consumption or third-party charges. Discount and credit are only available where (i) Customer accepts the Pilot Completion Report signed by both Parties, and (ii) Customer executes the Order Form without material changes to the scope of services.

Notes: (1) We should tie the Pilot Completion Report to two objective metrics (latency < X for 7/14 days and logs retention configured). (2) We’ll include a clause excluding change-of-control or M&A from the eligibility window. (3) The credit expiration: 6 months from Order Form signature.

I’ll iterate if you want more prescriptive gating. Legal can bless this as-is for commercial drafts.

Irene Choi
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medstream.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@medstream.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jul 2025 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing question (pilot -> prod)

Diego / team — appreciate the fast turnaround. Two clarifications before we take to CFO: 

1) Can you confirm the exact objective for the latency gate you mentioned? We need a numeric value to include in our board packet.
2) The 90-day conversion window is tight for our procurement cycles. Would you consider a 120-day window if we extend payment to a 36-month amortization schedule?

If you can confirm numbers today we’ll prepare a term sheet to share with finance tomorrow.

Thanks,
Tom
Director of IT, MedStream Health

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medstream.ai>, Ellie Harper <ellie.harper@medstream.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jul 2025 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing question (pilot -> prod)

Tom — quick answers to help your board packet: 

1) Latency gate: 95th percentile tail latency for the evaluation endpoints <= 220ms across a 14-day window with production-like concurrency (we specified the concurrency in the SOW appendix). That is the metric we will include in the Pilot Completion Report.
2) We can move to a 120-day conversion window if MedStream agrees to either (a) a 36-month amortization schedule or (b) a 12-month prepay covering 50% of the initial platform fee. In that case Redwood will honor the 18% platform fee discount and the onboarding credit as previously described.

I’ll leave the final contract mechanics to Irene and Marissa for precise wording; if you want I can also ask our finance team to produce a short TCO comparison (36-month amortized vs 24-month) by COB tomorrow.

Best,
Diego
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
